dim.description: the dimension along which to narrow
constraints: start + length must be less than or equal to the size of dimension dim in input Tensor

start.description: index of the element to start the narrowed dimension from. Can be negative, which means indexing from the end of `dim`. If `Tensor`, it must be an 0-dim integral `Tensor` (bools not allowed)
constraints: must be an integer or a 0-dim integral Tensor
if Tensor, it must have 0 dimensions and be an integral type
start + length must be less than or equal to the size of dimension dim in input Tensor

length.description: length of the narrowed dimension, must be weakly positive
constraints: start + length must be less than or equal to the size of dimension dim in input Tensor

output.description: a new tensor that is a narrowed version of input tensor

constraints: start + length must be less than or equal to the size of dimension dim in input Tensor
